chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: The Reduce method reduces an array to a single value.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: It executes a provided function for each value in the array and the returned value is stored in an accumulator.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: The function is not executed for array elements without values and it does not change the original array.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Here's the basic syntax of Reduce.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: First, we create a new variable.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Then, we reference the array and add.reduce.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: The Reduce method accepts two parameters.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: The first is a function. The function has access to the accumulator, current value, current index, and the entire original array.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: The second parameter after the function is an optional initial value for the accumulator.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: If the initial value is not included, the first element in the array will be used and skipped.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Here is a very basic example.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: We have an array of numbers.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Our goal is to add up all of the numbers.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: First, let's see how this can be accomplished with a for loop.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: We could create a variable called sum, setting the initial value to 0.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Then, create a for loop that adds each number to the sum variable, ending up with an accumulated sum.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: This works fine, but there is a more elegant way of doing this using the Reduce method.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: We can use the sum variable and assign it to the value of the array reduced.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Within the Reduce method, we have our accumulator, which I'll call total, and the current value, which I'll call value.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Now, we'll return the total plus the value.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: We can also set our initial value to 0.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: So now, as it iterates through the array, it is adding all of the numbers to the accumulator, and we end up with the total.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: We can further reduce the amount of code by getting rid of the curly braces, the return,

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: and in this case, we can leave out the initial value, and it will use the first element in the array as the initial value and skip it.

chunks.title: JavaScript Array Reduce Method
chunks.text: Now, we have just one line of code.
